description: Tool to capture payment on an uncaptured charge. Use when a charge was created with capture=false and you're ready to capture the payment.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for capturing a charge.

amount.description: The amount to capture in cents (or smallest currency unit). If not specified, the full amount is captured. Cannot exceed the original, uncaptured amount of the charge.
amount.title: Amount

application_fee_amount.description: An application fee amount to add to this charge, not exceeding the original amount.
application_fee_amount.title: Application Fee Amount

charge.description: The identifier of the charge to be captured. Typically starts with 'ch_'.
charge.title: Charge

receipt_email.description: The email address to send the receipt to. Overrides the charge's receipt_email. Maximum 800 characters. Receipts are not sent in test mode.
receipt_email.title: Receipt Email

statement_descriptor.description: Statement descriptor text for non-card charges with 22-character limit. For card charges, ignored if statement_descriptor_suffix is provided.
statement_descriptor.title: Statement Descriptor

statement_descriptor_suffix.description: Suffix concatenated to account's statement descriptor prefix for card charges.
statement_descriptor_suffix.title: Statement Descriptor Suffix

transfer_data_amount.description: The amount to transfer to the destination account without creating an Application Fee object. Must be used with Stripe Connect.
transfer_data_amount.title: Transfer Data Amount

transfer_group.description: Transaction group identifier. May only be provided if not previously set.
transfer_group.title: Transfer Group

inputSchema.title: CaptureChargeRequest

name: capture_charge

city.description: City, district, suburb, town, or village.
city.title: City

line1.description: Address line 1 (e.g., street, PO Box, or company name).
line1.title: Line1

line2.description: Address line 2 (e.g., apartment, suite, unit, or building).
line2.title: Line2

BillingDetails.description: Billing information associated with the payment method.
BillingDetails.title: BillingDetails

CaptureChargeResponse.description: Contains detailed information of the captured charge.

transfer_group.description: A string that identifies this transaction as part of a group.
transfer_group.title: Transfer Group

billing_details.description: Billing information associated with the payment method at the time of the transaction.
billing_details.title: Billing Details

disputed.description: Whether the charge has been disputed.
disputed.title: Disputed

refunds.description: A list of refunds that have been applied to the charge.
refunds.title: Refunds

failure_code.description: Error code explaining reason for charge failure if available.
failure_code.title: Failure Code

application.description: ID of the Connect application that created the charge.
application.title: Application

failure_balance_transaction.description: ID of the balance transaction that describes the reversal of the balance on your account due to payment failure.
failure_balance_transaction.title: Failure Balance Transaction

refunded.description: Whether the charge has been fully refunded. If the charge is only partially refunded, this attribute will still be false.
refunded.title: Refunded

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users.
description.title: Description

paid.description: true if the charge succeeded, or was successfully authorized for later capture.
paid.title: Paid

failure_message.description: Message to user further explaining reason for charge failure if available.
failure_message.title: Failure Message

amount_refunded.description: Amount in cents (or other smallest currency unit) refunded (can be less than the amount attribute on the charge if a partial refund was issued).
amount_refunded.title: Amount Refunded

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

status.description: The status of the payment is either succeeded, pending, or failed.
status.title: Status

payment_method_details.description: Details about the payment method at the time of the transaction.
payment_method_details.title: Payment Method Details

customer.description: ID of the customer this charge is for if one exists.
customer.title: Customer

application_fee.description: The application fee (if any) for the charge.
application_fee.title: Application Fee

review.description: ID of the review associated with this charge if one exists.
review.title: Review

calculated_statement_descriptor.description: The full statement descriptor that is passed to card networks, and that is displayed on your customer's credit card statement.
calculated_statement_descriptor.title: Calculated Statement Descriptor

payment_intent.description: ID of the PaymentIntent associated with this charge, if one exists.
payment_intent.title: Payment Intent

application_fee_amount.description: The amount of the application fee (if any) requested for the charge.
application_fee_amount.title: Application Fee Amount

on_behalf_of.description: The account (if any) the charge was made on behalf of without triggering an automatic transfer.
on_behalf_of.title: On Behalf Of

receipt_url.description: This is the URL to view the receipt for this charge. The receipt is kept up-to-date to the latest state of the charge.
receipt_url.title: Receipt Url

receipt_number.description: This is the transaction number that appears on email receipts sent for this charge.
receipt_number.title: Receipt Number

balance_transaction.description: ID of the balance transaction that describes the impact of this charge on your account balance (not including refunds or disputes).
balance_transaction.title: Balance Transaction

transfer_data.description: An optional dictionary including the account to automatically transfer to as part of a destination charge.
transfer_data.title: Transfer Data

amount_captured.description: Amount in cents (or other smallest currency unit) captured (can be less than the amount attribute on the charge if a partial capture was made).
amount_captured.title: Amount Captured

receipt_email.description: This is the email address that the receipt for this charge was sent to.
receipt_email.title: Receipt Email

statement_descriptor_suffix.description: Provides information about the charge that customers see on their statements.
statement_descriptor_suffix.title: Statement Descriptor Suffix

reason.description: An enumerated value providing a more detailed explanation of the outcome's type.

seller_message.description: A human-readable description of the outcome type and reason, designed for you (the recipient of the payment), not your customer.

type.description: Possible values are authorized, manual_review, issuer_declined, blocked, and invalid.
